what: When the video and photo stage stuck to the screen passes the middle of the start marker, it blurs by 24px in 1.6s and a stage-colored overlay settles to .5. When it passes the top edge of the stop marker, only the blur clears over the same length and the overlay stays — it is not tied to scroll but spreads once on crossing the threshold, and the poem and tagline pass over it. The video is always 1.06x so the blurred edges never show gaps.

options.from: Start-marker selector that turns the blur on — it turns on once it passes that element’s at point (default center). If none, the start screen height
options.to: Selector for the pause marker that turns blur off — once its top edge passes, only the blur clears. If none, it runs to the end
options.at: Point within the start indicator that lights up (0~1), default .5
options.start: Scroll point that triggers when there is no from (multiple of screen height), default 1
options.blur: Blur (px), default 24 — phone original is also 24
options.keep-veil: If false, the cover also lifts when passing the stop marker (default: the cover stays)
options.dur: Time for blur and cover to change (s), default 1.6
options.ease: Curve in the form “0.19,1,0.22,1”, default is that value
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Blurring video/photo (child) — without it the stage itself blurs

note: The stage covers the screen with position: fixed — give a higher z-index to sections passing over it. Showing and hiding the stage (70vh fade after the hero) is handled by the consuming side

from.where: index.html .rt-stage (from the center of the black 270vh section → top edge of the blur-stop section, original inline script #video-blur · #video-blur-overlay)
